propositions: Canonical CLI `rebar bridge preview` and `rebar bridge sync` routes must be primary while legacy `rebar reconcile` and `rebar.reconcile()` remain callable with historical defaults and behavior unchanged

Legacy `--mode` and `--filter-local-ids` must remain supported with documented semantics; canonical `--only` and `--except` must filter differ inputs before examination while legacy flag filters writes after full examination
All selection tokens in `--only`/`--except` must resolve to existing local IDs or Jira keys before lock acquisition; unresolved, partial, or wholly missing selections must exit 2 before mutation
Selection targets that disappear between preflight resolution and locked load must exit 2, name missing IDs, release lock, and skip differ/applier/manifest/persistence seams
Capped live runs with `--max-changes` must retain deterministic applied/deferred manifests; uncapped live and legacy bootstrap must remove temporary manifest per existing behavior

Production workflow must use canonical vocabulary except `reconcile-check` which remains lock-free diagnostic; legacy CLI/direct-engine/library/MCP/external-helper entrypoints must retain compatibility adapters
